title: Alya hub V1
features:
Custom Alya Theme UI: Features a high-quality Alya background with adjustable transparency for a premium "hacker" aesthetic.
Anti-Cheat Bypasser: Uses Metatable Spoofing to hide your WalkSpeed and JumpPower from the game's detection system.
Auto-Divine Farm: Automatically detects and teleports you to "Divine Brainrots" the moment they spawn.
Auto-Money Magnet: Smoothly tweens all nearby Coins, Yen, and Cash directly to your character's position.
Tsunami Immunity: Disables the "Swimming" state to prevent water damage, allowing you to walk freely during the Tsunami.
VIP Area Bypass: Removes collisions on all VIP/Gamepass doors so you can enter restricted zones for free.
Clear Vision: Automatically removes Fog, Atmosphere, and Bloom effects so you can see across the entire map.
Mobile Optimized: Specifically designed to run smoothly on executors like Delta without crashing your FPS.
Hideable Menu: Toggle the entire GUI on or off with a single button or the 'X' key for stealthy gameplay.
